notes: Window = union of a 250 m disc at the origin and a 120 m disc around every graph node whose kind is in exit_kinds (exit connector) or whose floorId is in street_floor_ids (street-level node); graph.json of stations/ikebukuro/gteki is read-only and its sha256 goes in the receipt. The window touches third-level meshes 53394576 and 53394577 only (plus 50 m mesh_margin_m for features that straddle a mesh edge; a third mesh, 53394586, first matters at roughly 100 m); a missing or unacquired mesh fails the run. Default merge kind = one building mesh and one road mesh. Visual-only context (gteki_role context, NOT_FOR_ROUTING); textures are not converted.
